Command center

Core 83 at a glance

Your numbers, your divisions, and your partners as a living network. Numbers without live data carry an “as of” date, and turn orange when they're stale.

Branch off a new business

Describe it. Cortana designs its business model and a partner team for every part of it.

Business

Add a partner

Assets: businesses you build for others

Use what you've built to help other people start something. Take their information, and Core 83 designs a business around their skills, time and money: why it fits them, a 30-day plan, the path to a first dollar, a partner team, and how you can help. Each one becomes its own business here and a client in your pipeline. Only enter what the person has agreed to share.

Their information

Clients

Everyone you're selling to or working with, from first lead to paying client. Follow-ups that come due land in your Action queue, wins are recorded with the Sales partner, and Cortana can prep you before any call.

Add a client

What's this meeting about?

Both meeting buttons use this. The partners treat your information as current facts, and any decision you state here is locked.

Short meeting

A quick huddle, about a minute. Cortana recaps everything since the last meeting, including research and your chats, then gives her recommendations, this week's priorities and the decisions waiting on you.

Long meeting

A full board meeting, a few minutes. Every partner reports in depth, the partners discuss the agenda with each other, and Cortana writes full minutes: decisions, action items with owners and dates, risks, recommendations and the next agenda.

Everything this business has been through: every meeting, every research session with what each bot found, your chats with Cortana, and her recommendations. Tap any entry to open it.

Engine bay: check engine

Every research engine gets a check engine light. Diagnostics inspect the engine's design (coverage, overlaps, weak bots, the sites they search, how results are scored) and its track record (errors, low confidence, bots the brain keeps sending back, Vault issues), then recommend fixes you can apply in one tap. New engines are checked as soon as they're built.

Research Standard · the rules every research bot follows
Build a research engine

Describe what you need researched. The brain designs twelve bots for it, each covering a different kind of source.

Attachments

Screenshots, photos, charts, notes. Cortana reads each one, the swarm uses them as evidence, and you can ask questions about any of them. They stay with this session.

Swarm options

Gather

Every research bot, in one place

Every bot from every engine you build lands here. Pick the ones you want (up to 12), give them one mission, and they research it together. Skeptic and Verify always join.

How accurate is Core 83?

Log a prediction

Write it your way. The checker tightens it so a stranger could settle it on the due date, then you log it. Sessions can also make predictions from their findings.

Recap

What was learned and made each day across all of Core 83: research, meetings, chats with Cortana, predictions, partner ledgers, the Vault and your build list, written up as the lessons worth keeping.

Made that day

Cells are the main pieces of data from across Core 83, pulled out of every research session, bot report, meeting, chat, lesson, prediction, client and attachment, so you can find one specific thing without scrolling through sessions. The whole plan for Core 83

Governance layer

Vault Orchestrator

Works alongside everything Core 83 does. It sets grounding rules for every answer, audits important outputs for unsupported claims, contradictions, drift and overconfidence, scans your records for conflicts, and learns rules from its own findings so Core 83 gets more reliable over time.

Governance level

Stability

Grounding rules

Added to every request Core 83 sends to Claude while the Vault is on.

Latest scan

No scan yet. A scan checks your whole platform for contradictions between records, work drifting from your goals, and items going stale.

Everything you're working on outside Core 83

Road Map

Your projects, your week, and a coach that studies your days. Projects feed your Action queue and predictions, Cortana knows all of it, and once your week is in, she plans each day around it and looks for where you can do better.

Weekly schedule

Your fixed commitments each day: work shifts, family, appointments. Cortana plans around these.

Where you can do better

Enter your week, then press “Review my days with Cortana”. She studies your routine, your day plans and what actually got done, then suggests changes and a week of time blocks for your projects.
